summary: No Forest Service page designates camping at the paved lot at the US-48 end of FR 344 (Lee Ranger District, George Washington and Jefferson NF). The forest's General Prohibitions order bans camping 'in or within 300 feet of any developed parking area', and its dispersed-camping page says dispersed camping is not allowed near trailheads or other developed recreation areas, so no booking values are recorded for the lot itself. FR 344 open to motorhomes April 1 - January 15 (MVUM). Free fee (AWH, manual) and AWH note left.
flags: Criteria: overnight camping at this lot appears to be prohibited. George Washington and Jefferson NF Forest Order 08-08-00-23-3 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts/general-prohibitions, in force to August 30, 2028) prohibits 'Camping in or within 300 feet of any developed parking area or boat ramp', and the forest's dispersed-camping page (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins) says 'Dispersed camping is not allowed in the vicinity of developed recreation areas such as campgrounds, picnic areas, or trailheads.' The entry's pin is on a paved surface parking lot (OSM way 754048214, 'large paved parking lot' per AWH's note) at the foot of FR 344, so it is a developed parking area if it is on National Forest land; no Forest Service page designates it for camping. The entry's 'paved overnight parking area' inclusion evidence is Campendium/The Dyrt only. The legal dispersed sites are the FR 344 campsites (401 is ~190 m away, outside the 300-ft buffer).

Missing website: no Forest Service page designates this lot or names campsites on FR 344; the George Washington and Jefferson NF has no recreation page for Squirrel Gap. Agency pages that govern it: the forest's dispersed-camping page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/camping-cabins and the General Prohibitions forest order https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/alerts/general-prohibitions. Missing phone: Lee Ranger District, Edinburg VA, 540-984-4101 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/offices).

Road, for information: Forest Service Motor Vehicle Use Map data (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_MVUM_01/MapServer/1, queried 2026-10-21): the lot sits at the start of NFSR WV344 'Squirrel Gap', Lee Ranger District, George Washington and Jefferson National Forest; maintenance level '3 - SUITABLE FOR PASSENGER CARS', crushed aggregate/gravel, 'Roads open to highway legal vehicles only, Seasonal': motorhomes (and passenger cars) open 04/01-01/15, so the road is closed to vehicles January 16 - March 31. No current George Washington and Jefferson alert or forest order closes FR 344 (alerts page read 2026-10-21). No agency page recommends high clearance or 4WD.
Managing agency: George Washington and Jefferson National Forests, Lee Ranger District (FS road layer admin org 080804; MVUM districtname 'Lee Ranger District'); ownership federal is right.
